title: Approximation of the clone value
statement: Let $V$ be a set on which equality is decidable, and let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with a uniform refinement over a finite predicate template. For natural numbers $r,M$ with $0<M$ and $r\le M$, suppose every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$. For every assignment of values in $D$ to the pairs in $V\times\{0,\ldots,M-1\}$, the absolute difference between its padded-clone value and its value on the raw CSP instance formed from globally filtered clone occurrences is at most $r^2/M$.
hypotheses_covered: Every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$
